title: Proper marked curve contractions and exceptional trees
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-field] [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Let $(C',D')\to(C,D)$ be a proper modification of proper multipointed $k$-curves [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-trf-multipointed-curve] [def-trf-multipointed-curve-modification], with geometrically reduced source and target curves [lem-trf-nodal-geometric-fibres-reduced]. Let $x\in C(k)$ and let $Z$ be the scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] over $x$, assumed to be a connected curve [def-weil-connected-scheme]; assume the map is an isomorphism away from $x$ and $(C',D')$ is semistable [def-trf-semistable-multipointed-pair] at every point of $Z$. Put $\partial(Z)=Z\cap\overline{C'\setminus Z}$ in $C'$. Then $(C,D)$ is semistable [def-trf-semistable-multipointed-pair] at $x$ if and only if $Z$ is an exceptional $\mathbf P^1_k$-tree: a connected [def-weil-connected-scheme] proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] nodal curve [def-trf-nodal-geometric-fibres] whose components are projective lines [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change] and whose incidence graph is a tree, with $|\partial(Z)|+|D'\cap Z|\le 2$..
